name: opensips-skills
description: OpenSIPs Agent Skills for Claude Code: route script authoring, per-module reference, and security review across 12 vulnerability families.

plugins.name: opensips
plugins.description: Two Agent Skills: (1) opensips-config authors and edits opensips.cfg, looks up module exports, and grounds Claude in version-specific OpenSIPs reference data; (2) opensips-security-advisor reviews opensips.cfg for security issues across 12 vulnerability families with severity-ranked findings and cited remediations. Covers OpenSIPs 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, and 4.0.
